correctness.rationale: Exact spherical integral identifies all four coefficients and rules out the zero vector. The cotangent ratio is strictly monotone on each interval between its poles. This yields all projective fibers and the sharp closed-ball pi threshold. Euler sine partial fractions bound both radial and tangential eigenvalues of DY below by kappa/3, giving a sharp global inverse estimate by convexity. A real affine coefficient matrix proves the rank law, and the Gram identity follows by elementary algebra. The standalone 914 finite checks agree.
